learning_outcomes.text: To be able to solve Turkey's problems by using the terminology and perspective of social sciences.

syllabus_topics: Methodology of the science of sociology
Ottoman accumulation and Ataturk's revolutions as the basic social structure in Turkey
Foundation of nation state and development of capitalism
Advances in agriculture and industry in Turkey
Population as an indicator of social structure
City and family as an indicator of social structure
The origins of the capitalist class and the upper class layer structure in Turkey
Middle classes in Turkey and the dissolvent of these classes in the economic strength hierarchy
The unique nature of class society and the distribution of income as an indicator of class in Turkey
The place of military and civil bureaucracy in the transformation process of Turkish society
The spread of popular culture and mass culture in Turkey
bibliography: Giddens A., Sosyoloji, Ayraç Yay. Evi, Ankara, 2002.
Kongar E., 21. Yüzyılda Türkiye, Remzi Kitap Evi, Ankara, 2002.
